headline: Fox (FOXA) Could Be 20% Undervalued As Its Digital Growth Narrative Builds
summary: Fox (FOXA) is back in focus after a fresh update on its FOX AdStudio partnership with iSpot, which expands always on attribution and real time outcomes measurement across the company’s advertising portfolio. See our latest analysis for Fox. Fox’s latest move with iSpot comes as the stock trades at US$58.95, with a 1 month share price return of 16.99% but a year to date share price decline of 20.08%, while the 5 year total shareholder return of 80.11% points to stronger longer term performance...
